publishedText.value: Binary M0 with jointly independent Bernoulli(p) latent lineages, known p in(0,1), uniform shares1/K with K>=1 and0<c<=1: the exact population pair and fourth agreement moments identify(c,K). A general quartic expectation bridge and strict monotonicity prove this beyond the old finite grid. For arbitrary normalized weights, p declared is insufficient for this moment map: c=7/10,K_eff=147/4 and c=4/5,K_eff=48 have equal R2,R4 at p=3/4. This collision concerns these moments only, not the entire observable law. R3 remains redundant. No sample uncertainty, causal recovery or contextual activity identification is claimed.

model.latent: Per cell, jointly independent Bernoulli(p) named lineages with declared normalized shares, shared copy probabilityc, fresh member draws. Latent/fresh randomness independent across cells.
model.mean: E U_t=2p(1-p)*(1-c^2*sum(w_l^2)) exactly for finiteN under this observation design.
model.members: Conditional population draws with replacement, independent given the cell latent lineages. Fixed lineage quotas/distinct finite-population member samples require their gamma_N correction and are not this profile.
model.optionalCap: A known deterministic cap is an explicit additional premise. A merely probabilistic cap would require another failure budget and is outside this profile.
model.output: Conditional outer enclosure for K_eff, not exact identified-set equality, latent causal groups, probability of truth or a physical count of independent sources.
model.statistic: U_t=(sum of discordant unordered member pairs)/choose(N,2)=2X_t(N-X_t)/(N(N-1)); Dhat=mean over whole cells. Shared-member pairs need not be independent.

publishedText.value: Under the declared binary M0 conditional-population-iid member design, finite-cell pair discord has the published population disagreement mean. ForT jointly independent complete cells, the all-pairs average is a bounded whole-cell statistic: its tail is at most min(1,1/(4T epsilon^2)), not a bound withT multiplied by the number of pairs. External coverage-calibrated p,c boxes and their union error budgets propagate through the positive M0 denominator to a conditional outer K_eff enclosure. A denominator that may approach zero has no certified finite upper bound unless a valid external cap is declared. Missing calibration is unmeasured; an incompatible confidence box is not an unconditional rejection of the model. No finite interval establishes causal independence.

publishedText.classification: definitions and conditional interpretation; no new law

definitions.effectiveParticipation: For finite nonnegative masses a_i with positive total, w_i=a_i/sum(a), K_eff=1/sum(w_i^2). Dimensionless; zeros do not count as active support. It measures weight concentration, not causally independent extensions.
definitions.extension: A5 supplied set of coordinate/interval pairs ext(o), compared at fixed coordinate interpretation, resolution and context. Equality is extensional equivalence under that convention; it does not identify historical actors, causal processes or independent random variables.
definitions.jointIndependence: For declared variables and one probability law, every joint event factors into the product of its marginal probabilities. For a conditional claim, declare the conditioning variable and require factorization in each positive-mass stratum. Pairwise zero covariance, distinct names and disjoint extensions do not imply this.
definitions.namedLineage: A supplied model label grouping sources by a declared common generation/ancestry mechanism, with membership and any active weighting supplied. Labels and extension distances do not certify that mechanism. Observational identification remains conditional.
definitions.spectralParticipation: For nonnegative eigenvalues lambda_i of a declared symmetric PSD covariance with positive trace, normalize w_i=lambda_i/trace: K_eff=trace(C)^2/tr(C^2). This spectral measure and a declared lineage-weight measure are distinct objects unless a model connects them.

reusedEvidence.uniformIdentification: admitted O4 uniform_population_identification, known p and uniform weights only

scopeConditions.A7: Fixed coordinates, resolution, context and ceilings; adding live narrowing constraints cannot increase summed finite log-cardinal freedoms. Withdrawal and witnessed local widening can increase freedom on an existing coordinate. A sum over coordinates is not automatically joint Shannon entropy.
scopeConditions.A9: Representation convention for the object relation; supplies no iteration theorem or independence premise.
scopeConditions.C1: Historical independence-is-distance wording is not probabilistic factorization; any probabilistic reading needs a separately supplied joint law and independence proof.
scopeConditions.T90: Nonempty finite admissible states, uniform distribution at fixed resolution: entropy=log2(cardinality). Arbitrary priors, phase interpretations and exclusive lists of freedom-changing acts do not follow. Empty regions need their separately declared algebraic state, not an invented entropy convention.
scopeConditions.T99: Finite world and records, acyclic reachable dependency graph, total supplied lattice operations. Finite dependency evaluation is not repeated application of an arbitrary monotone map. Reachable ancestral cycles reject; unreachable cycles do not affect the query. General iterative convergence needs a carrier, operator, seed and progress/height hypotheses.

publishedText.value: Exact M0 independent-Bernoulli expectation gives R2=p^2+(1-p)^2+2c^2 p(1-p) sum w^2 for normalized declared shares; this identity is checked generally in Lean by expect_quadratic and pair_coincidence. Triple agreement satisfies R3=(3R2-1)/2 and adds no independent equation. Population agreement is not majority error or causal identification. Finite distinct-member sampling needs gamma_N, and observed data still need calibration, justified reference and uncertainty.
